description: Read the GBLIN rebalancing auction on Base. The vault does not rebalance itself and pays nobody to do it: when a basket row drifts past its band it holds a Dutch auction, and whoever trades with it toward the target weights is the counterparty, at the oracle price adjusted by a premium that starts at a discount and rises to a cap over one ramp. Returns, per row, the side the vault takes, the gap in ETH, the token and amount the bidder hands over, and unsigned calldata (approval + bid). The premium is the whole reward; nothing is paid out of the vault.
name: get_auction_state

best.description: The row with the largest gap, or null.

openedAt.description: When the auction opened, or null when closed.

premiumBps.description: Current premium over the oracle price, in basis points; negative is a discount.

rows.description: One entry per basket asset: side, gap from target and amount a bidder can fill.
